description: Multi-agent KPI-drop investigator: competing hypotheses tested against Zetaris views, a deterministic Claim Gate, an evidence graph in Meterless H-MEM, and a decision memo with row-level citations and a formula-based confidence.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsor_technology.zetaris: Default data layer: five views (v_orders, v_returns, v_tickets, v_logistics, v_promotions) queried over JDBC (Zetaris Lightning) by the Retriever and re-queried by the Evidence Evaluator and Claim Gate. When Zetaris is not configured the same SQL runs on a local DuckDB snapshot (SAMPLE_MODE, the explicit fallback), which is logged and shown in the memo.

meterless.where: H-MEM stores hypotheses, retrieval calls, evidence and support/refute edges (trust ledger exported per run); Markovian drives the Evaluator->Planner investigation rounds. Open-source reference engines vendored (Apache-2.0) and run via a node bridge; a missing node is logged and can be made fatal with METERLESS_REQUIRED=1. Meterless Nightshift was not available; a labelled local Nightshift-compatible simulator is included.

sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (S2: Planner, Cause Analyst, Writer), Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (S1: agentic retriever, relevance filter, Evidence Evaluator) and nemotron-3-embed-1b embeddings via the NVIDIA endpoint; live dev-split results in eval/RESULTS_dev_nvidia.md.
sponsor_technology.unique: The Evidence Evaluator re-queries the data itself and can send the Planner back; a deterministic Claim Gate blocks any claim or model-written number that the data does not support.

sample_mode: fallback when Zetaris is not configured (SAMPLE_MODE=true forces it)
data: Synthetic only (scripts/make_data.py, seeded); no real customer data.
ai_usage: Code written during the build window by AI coding agents (Grok Bot) under the author's direction; see README 'AI and Model Usage'.
